review.brief:
Review change RM57-gateway-authorize-supercharger-reads (module gateway, roadmap RM57 tier 4). Read the diff of commit 7142d07 - not the whole module.

WHAT IT DOES: SuperchargerRowUpdate reads the selected vehicle from the session (currentVehicle), proves it with authorizeVehicle, and passes the resulting vehicleref.Ref to charging's VerifySession. The two Supercharger READ sites deliberately keep resolveSelectedVehicle.

VALIDATE:
1. Anti-gaming, the most important check here. Moving to currentVehicle broke tests that relied on resolveSelectedVehicle's auto-select. The fix must be SEEDING THE SESSION in test setup, never relaxing an assertion. Verify NO test changed an expected status, an assertion, an expected call count, or an expected argument. The leader already checked this and found none - confirm independently. Any weakened test is a blocker finding.
2. The two read sites (superchargerStatsViewFor, fetchSuperchargerRowVM) must NOT call authorizeVehicle. Adding it would cost a second RegisteredVehicles query per render and discard the Ref, since the read ports still take int64. Their comments must say why the existing call is already an ownership proof.
3. Both write-path failure branches must return 404, never 403. A 403 confirms a probed vehicle id is real. Check the error text resolves through i18n.T with an existing key.
4. Query cost: exactly ONE RegisteredVehicles call on the write path, not two.
5. Behaviour change to judge: a PATCH with no vehicle in the session now returns 404 instead of auto-selecting a car. Confirm the code and the tests agree this is intended, and that a real save always follows a render that set the session.
6. Module boundary: the gateway calls module ports only, never a database. No HTML outside the gateway.
7. Docs track change: internal/gateway/AGENTS.md, the five kkpa/context guides and INDEX.md.
8. Spec coverage: specs/gateway/spec.md matches what shipped.

NOT A FINDING: gofmt reports internal/gateway/vehicle_image_test.go. It is pre-existing from commit 33716e6, untouched by this change, and deliberately left alone so unrelated work stays out of this diff.

SIGNALS - who ran what: the assistant and the leader ran go build ./... (whole repo, GREEN), go vet, gofmt -l, and the vehicleref, boundary, i18n and archive guards - all clean. The TEST SUITE was run by the OWNER, who reported `make test` passing. Judge test quality by READING the tests, never by running them.

TEST-EXECUTION-POLICY (verbatim): Claude writes tests but never runs the suite - never go test ./..., make test, make test-with-db or make check. It MAY run go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, make build, make vet, make bins, and the standalone guards. The owner runs the suite and reports results; work that is complete but unexecuted is awaiting-user-verification, never done, and a passing suite is recorded as the owner's report, never claimed by the assistant.

B2 WRITING RULE (verbatim, binds every word you write): Short sentences - one idea each, 15 words or fewer. Common words only: no idioms, no phrasal verbs, no rare vocabulary - write 'use' not 'leverage', 'start' not 'kick off', 'problem' not 'caveat'. Keep technical terms in English and never rename or simplify an identifier, but explain the result in simple words. No filler. Code comments say WHY and must never cite design.md, a decision ID, a change ID, a roadmap ID or a tier number.

PERFORMANCE-PROFILE (verbatim): read-heavy - read performance is mandatory over write performance; writes are mostly done by pollers at midnight, so denormalizing, indexing aggressively, and precomputing for reads is acceptable - never at the cost of the modular-monolith boundaries or module data ownership.

rounds.notes: Read the doc pack (CLAUDE.md, ai/architecture.md, ai/go-conventions.md, ai/agentic-workflow.md, internal/gateway/AGENTS.md) plus the change artifacts and the archived MAG-66 design.md. Reviewed the diff of commit 7142d07 only. Anti-gaming check: read supercharger_test.go's diff in full. No expected status, assertion, call count, or argument value changed in any test. Only superchargerRowEngine's two new trailing params (session seed) and doc comments changed. Confirmed via design.md's own Test Contract table and the actual diff. The two read sites (superchargerStatsViewFor, fetchSuperchargerRowVM) still call resolveSelectedVehicle only, each with a new short comment explaining why RegisteredVehicles filtering there is already the ownership proof; neither calls authorizeVehicle. Both write-path failure branches (currentVehicle miss, authorizeVehicle error) return HTTP 404 with i18n.KeySuperchargerErrorSessionNotFound, which has both ES and EN in the catalogue. Query cost on the write path: currentVehicle is a session read (no query), authorizeVehicle makes exactly one RegisteredVehicles call - confirmed by reading handlers.go's authorizeVehicle body. Behaviour change (no session vehicle -> 404, no auto-select) matches design.md D1 and the updated spec scenario, and matches the test TestSuperchargerRowUpdate_NoResolvableVehicleIs404. Module boundary: supercharger.go imports only charging, gateway/i18n, gateway/templates packages, gin, uuid - no DB import, confirmed clean by make boundary-guard, make vehicleref-guard, make i18n-guard, make archive-guard, go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l (only pre-existing vehicle_image_test.go, untouched by this diff, exactly as the brief said). Docs: internal/gateway/AGENTS.md and the six kkpa/context files (INDEX.md, charge-record-mutation.md, gateway-reader-writer-ports.md, vehicle-ownership-proof.md, supercharger-stats.md, verify-session-battery.md) all match the shipped code; a seventh file, kkpa/context/workflows/supercharger-stats-read.md, was also updated for the same reason though not listed in tasks.md/design.md - a helpful addition, not a gap. specs/gateway/spec.md's modified requirement and its four scenarios match the shipped behaviour exactly (CSRF before ownership, 404 on no-selection, 404 on wrong-account vehicle, scoped to session-selected vehicle). No comment added or changed by this diff cites design.md, a decision ID, a change ID, or a tier number - all decision-ID references were removed as part of this same change (D5). One pre-existing comment in SuperchargerRowUpdate's body ('D7c - range/type validation...') still cites a decision ID, but git diff confirms this line was not touched by commit 7142d07, so per the review brief's own pre-existing-comment rule this is out of scope and not a finding.
